summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Settings page with hamburger + slide-in Drawer. All 11 requested test scenarios PASSED. Customer Settings has only profile card + hamburger on main surface (no portfolio/bio/support/legal/logout inline). Barber Settings additionally shows bio field and portfolio section. Drawer opens/closes correctly (translate-x-0 / -translate-x-full), backdrop click closes it, password toggle collapses/expands, password mismatch error toast appears (كلمة المرور وتأكيدها غير متطابقتين), all 5 legal/info links navigate correctly to /app/about|contact|help|privacy|terms and drawer auto-closes before navigation, save profile shows تم حفظ التغييرات toast, logout shows تم تسجيل الخروج toast and lands on /auth. GPS update-location-btn correctly hidden for customer and shown for barber. drawer-support-call is <a href='tel:07812059874'>. Gold/black identity preserved (verified in screenshots).

issues: On short viewports (390x844) the pinned logout button may render just below the fold and required scroll_into_view during automation. Users on smaller phones may need to scroll to reach logout, though flex-1 body should shrink. Recommend verifying on iPhone SE-class devices — footer is shrink-0 so should stay visible in practice.

critical_code_review_comments: SettingsDrawer.jsx: navigator.share is called without a try around the whole promise resolution path — currently wrapped in try/catch which is fine. Verified share button does not throw in headless.

Settings.jsx: side-effect updateProfile fires inside onChange for avatar & portfolio (line 102, 129). If user rapidly changes files, multiple parallel PUTs can race. Consider debouncing or awaiting sequentially. Not blocking.
SettingsDrawer.jsx line 84: supportPhone fallback uses hardcoded '07812059874'. Acceptable fallback, but SUPPORT is imported so should always be present. No change needed.
No data-testid for onboarding-skip visibility issue observed — worked reliably after 4s wait for splash to dismiss.
